summary: This diff wires up PROJEXA's Permits, Drawings/3D, Documents-create, and Minutes-of-Meeting routes on the v1 Bearer-key surface, reusing the existing document-service.ts storage pattern and extending veri-meeting-service.ts to accept API-key actors via the already-established ServiceActor union. Auth is applied consistently (requireAuthOrApiKey + requireRoleOrScope('member','write') on every mutating route, auth-only on reads), tenant scoping goes through withTenantContext with orgId sourced from the authenticated context throughout, file uploads reuse the same 25MB size cap and filename-sanitization logic as the pre-existing internal /api/documents route, and external-link records are clearly flagged via metadata.isExternalLink so signed-URL generation is skipped correctly. New tenant-isolation tests exercise the real service functions against mocked withTenantContext and assert org-scoped calls never leak cross-org, and the new PDF generator has direct unit tests asserting a real non-empty %PDF-prefixed buffer. No schema/migration files, .env, auth internals, or .github/workflows/** are touched, consistent with the tier1 classification. Diff is additive and low-blast-radius; recommend merge.
issues: Permits POST returns the error "A PDF file is required" but never actually checks file.type === "application/pdf" -- any file type is accepted despite the message (pre-existing document-upload code elsewhere also skips MIME allowlisting, so this is a minor consistency/wording gap, not a new regression).

None of the new routes (permits/drawings POST, veri-meetings create) verify that the supplied projectId/linkedEntityId actually belongs to the caller's org before attaching a document/meeting to it -- matches this codebase's existing free-text linkedEntityType/linkedEntityId convention (schema.ts's own comment on the column) rather than being a new gap introduced here, but worth tightening in a follow-up if PROJEXA ever accepts cross-org-guessable IDs from less-trusted callers.
